# `fndef` records

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from schemas/0.1/fndef.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

An embedded library copy (doc 07 §2.1, doc 05 §13.2): `$k`, `id` (the copy ID
`v5(NS_LIBCOPY, library ‖ item)`), `$v`, the copy metadata, then the item's own members.

`sha256` is taken over the canonical compact JSON of the item's own members, without `id` and the copy
metadata, so the copy's hash equals the published item's (EW-CORE-014).

Deserialisation reads the copy metadata itself and hands the remaining members to the item's own
deserialiser, so errors inside the item keep their paths (a flattened field would lose them).

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `fndef` |
| File | `lib/fndefs/<id>.json` |
| Rank | null |
| Status | implemented |
| Record version | 1 |
| Schema | [`fndef.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/schemas/0.1/fndef.schema.json) |

### CpDef

One connection point of a function definition (doc 03 §7).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `alias` | [`Ident`](#ident) or `null` | no |  | Alias ("L1"). |
| `clamp` | [`ClampKey`](#clampkey) or `null` | no |  | Terminal clamp. |
| `designation` | [`Ident`](#ident) | yes |  | Printed designation; duplicates allowed (REF-029). |
| `discipline` | [`Discipline`](#discipline) | no |  | Discipline; default electrical. |
| `idx` | integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535) | yes |  | Internal, unique index. |
| `level` | integer (format `uint8`, min 0, max 255) or `null` | no |  | Terminal level. |
| `optional` | boolean | no |  | May stay free by design (EW-POT-009 skips it). |
| `physical` | boolean | no |  | A drawn, wireable point; default true (false for an internal VMPA coil). |
| `potential_role` | [`PotentialType`](#potentialtype) or `null` | no |  | Potential role (PSU "+" is L+). |
| `side` | [`Side`](#side) or `null` | no |  | Terminal side. |
| `source_output` | boolean | no |  | Output of a source function; roots potential flow. |

### ClampKey

The clamp of a terminal CP (doc 08 §2.3): `{"clamp": "a"}`, `{"shaft": 1}` or `"rail_foot"`.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: A wire clamp a, b, c ….

   Shape: object { `clamp`: string (at least 1 character(s), at most 1 character(s)) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `clamp` | string (at least 1 character(s), at most 1 character(s)) | yes |  |  |

2. **Form 2**: A bridge shaft.

   Shape: object { `shaft`: integer (format `uint8`, min 0, max 255) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `shaft` | integer (format `uint8`, min 0, max 255) | yes |  |  |

3. **Form 3**: The rail foot of a PE terminal.

   Shape: `"rail_foot"`

### Ident

An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### InternalKind

Kind of an internal link.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: A short: the CPs are one signal.

   Shape: `"short"`

2. **Form 2**: A pass-through pair: propagates the potential type; `opens` sets "switched".

   Shape: object { `pass_through`: [`PassThroughSpec`](#passthroughspec) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `pass_through` | [`PassThroughSpec`](#passthroughspec) | yes |  | The payload of `InternalKind::PassThrough`. |

### ItemMeta

Provenance of a library item (doc 07 §2.1, §2.5). The item's semantic version is the copy metadata
`version` of the `LibCopy` and is stored once, there.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |

| `confidence` | map of [`Confidence`](#confidence) | no |  | Confidence per section, keyed by section name. |
| `foreign_terms` | boolean | no |  | Imported content under foreign terms. |
| `key` | [`Ident`](#ident) or `null` | no |  | Human key (`pxc.2904602`, `ew.iec.mcb-1pn`). |
| `licence` | string or `null` | no |  | SPDX licence expression of the item. |
| `sources` | array of string | no |  | Where the data came from: datasheet references, file hashes, manual entry. |
| `status` | [`ItemStatus`](#itemstatus) | no |  | Item status; default released. |

### ItemStatus

Status of a library item.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: Draft.

   Shape: `"draft"`

2. **Form 2**: Released (the default).

   Shape: `"released"`

3. **Form 3**: Deprecated, with an optional successor: `{"deprecated": {"successor": …}}`.

   Shape: object { `deprecated`: [`Deprecation`](#deprecation) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `deprecated` | [`Deprecation`](#deprecation) | yes |  | The payload of `ItemStatus::Deprecated`. |

4. **Form 4**: Withdrawn.

   Shape: `"withdrawn"`
